name: PteroVM
author: afnanksalal@pterovm.local
description: noVNC desktop from one Java jar. The server port serves the desktop. The console prints the URL and the VNC password when it is ready. Install grabs the jar for this machine: x86_64, aarch64, or riscv64.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Fetches the PteroVM launcher for this machine. Does not delete the unpacked desktop.
set -eu
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${SERVER_JARFILE:-}" ]; then
    SERVER_JARFILE=server.jar
fi

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=x86_64 ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ARCH=aarch64 ;;
    riscv64) ARCH=riscv64 ;;
    *)
        echo "PteroVM is x86_64, aarch64, or riscv64. This machine is $(uname -m)."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading PteroVM"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}.partial" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}.partial" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
elif [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    echo "Keeping the existing ${SERVER_JARFILE}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/Afnanksalal/Ptero-vm/releases/download/v2.1-${ARCH}/pterovm-${ARCH}.jar"
    echo "Downloading PteroVM for ${ARCH}"
    curl -fL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 15 -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}.partial" "$URL"
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}.partial" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
fi

echo "PteroVM jar is ready."

variables.description: Jar file Wings starts. Leave this as server.jar.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional URL of a pterovm jar. Used only on install or reinstall. Leave blank and a missing jar is downloaded for this machine's arch.

variables.name: VNC Password
variables.description: Desktop password, 8 characters or fewer. Leave blank to keep the saved password. The console prints the password in use.
